title: Foo Bar Moose Create Analytics Table
description: Create a ClickHouse table for user activity events using the Moose framework, optimized for two query patterns: activity counts per user over a date range, and total duration per action type.
lede: In this scenario, an agent must use Moose to create an analytics table with an appropriate schema, load sample data, and verify two query patterns.

tasks.description: Create a ClickHouse table optimized for user activity analytics and verify with sample data.

infrastructure.description: Moose installed. No services prestarted. Sample data in /data/samples/user_activity_sample.csv.
